channel.title: Sudan - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Sudan, every source cited.

item.title: 1,150 flee North Darfur villages amid insecurity
item.description: Families from five villages in Um برو locality moved to other areas or crossed into Chad between October 29 and 31.

item.title: Sudanese poet Khalil Farrah's treatment recalled
item.description: A film about English poet John Keats draws parallels to Farrah's final days and restrictive diet.

item.title: Sudan army regrets South Sudanese mercenaries in war
item.description: Army chief al-Atta accused the RSF of recruiting tens of thousands of South Sudanese fighters as mercenaries.

item.title: Blue Nile IDPs face food, medicine shortages
item.description: Displaced people in Sudan's Blue Nile region are struggling with hunger, disease, and a lack of healthcare.

item.title: Sudan leader Burhan risks repeating Bashir's Russia gambit, analyst warns
item.description: Journalist Rasha Awad warns that seeking Russian investment mirrors former president Omar al-Bashir's failed strategy.
